astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Large Scale Structure of the Universe
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: This is a map of the universe. The Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) at Kitt Peak National Observatory, Arizona, has finished its five-year survey. It observed more than 47 million galaxies and quasars and created a 3D map centered on the Earth.
